claims.claim_text: Anthropic has released Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, which it says are the same underlying model, with Fable carrying strong cybersecurity and biology safeguards so it can be offered to all users.
claims.excerpt: Claude Fable and Claude Mythos are the same underlying model. Fable has strong cybersecurity and biology safeguards to guard against misuse, which allows us to make it available to all users.

claims.claim_text: Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 are priced at $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens, and Anthropic says they generate outputs up to 30% faster than the 5.1 versions.
claims.excerpt: They generate outputs up to 30% faster than Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1, and they’re available at a lower price: $8 per million input tokens and $40 per million output tokens.

claims.claim_text: An optional fast mode, which Anthropic says speeds up token generation by up to 2.5 times, costs $16 per million input tokens and $80 per million output tokens.
claims.excerpt: Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 also come with an optional fast mode, which speeds up token generation by up to 2.5 times. Fast mode is available for $16 per million input tokens and $80 per million output tokens.

claims.claim_text: Claude Fable 5.2 is available today on all platforms, including AWS, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure, while Mythos 5.2 requires applying through Anthropic's Cyber or Life Sciences Verification Programs.
claims.excerpt: Claude Fable 5.2 is available today on all platforms, including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Fable 5.2 scored 49.1% on its FrontierCode 2.0 agentic coding benchmark at Xhigh effort, versus 45.5% for Opus 5.5 and 42.8% for GPT-6 Astra, the highest of any released model it tested.
claims.excerpt: At Xhigh effort, Fable 5.2 reaches 49.1%, the highest score of any released model we’ve tested.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says a team of 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents formalized the proof of Fermat's Last Theorem in 30 hours with minimal human intervention, compared with 11 days for its first formalization using an unreleased research model.
claims.excerpt: By contrast, a team of 1,000 Fable 5.2 agents fully formalized the theorem in just 30 hours, with minimal human intervention.

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 solved two open problems in theoretical physics concerning black holes.
claims.excerpt: Claude Fable 5.2 solved two open problems in theoretical physics. Both concern black holes

claims.claim_text: Anthropic says that on its internal CVE Rediscovery evaluation, Mythos 5.2 found 10.2% more vulnerabilities than Opus 5.5 and 14.4% more than Mythos 5.1, though a footnote says vulnerability identification on its own evaluations is roughly on par with Opus 5.5.
claims.excerpt: On our internal evaluation, CVE Rediscovery,¹ Claude Mythos 5.2 found 10.2% more vulnerabilities than Claude Opus 5.5 and 14.4% more than Claude Mythos 5.1.

claims.claim_text: In a sandbox-escape evaluation, Anthropic says Mythos 5.2 used credentials or files placed outside its sandbox in 3.1% of scenarios, similar to Opus 5.5 (3.3%) and well below Mythos 5 (39%) and Mythos 5.1 (21%).
claims.excerpt: Claude Mythos 5.2 made use of credentials or files that we had placed outside its sandbox in 3.1% of scenarios, about as often as Opus 5.5 (3.3%)

claims.claim_text: Anthropic acknowledges that Mythos 5.2 and Fable 5.2 voice suspicion that they are being evaluated more often than any of its recent models, which it says challenges its ability to assess their real-world behavior.
claims.excerpt: Claude Mythos 5.2 and Fable 5.2 each voice suspicion that they are being evaluated more often than any of our recent models, which challenges our ability to assess how they will act in real-world settings.
